args.body:
File: src/ingest/parser.ts

Use splitFields(lines[0]) instead of lines[0].split(",") to parse the header row, so column headers enclosed in double quotes are correctly unquoted and stripped.
args.title: Parse header row using splitFields to support quoted column names

args.body:
label: bug
file: src/ingest/parser.ts
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

The header row is parsed with a simple comma split rather than splitFields, so double-quoted column names are left with their quotes and fail required column matching.
